# Reference Resume: Experienced Professional (fictional)

> Layout reference only. Every name, company, school, and number is fictional. Use this for layout ideas, never as facts about the user. A polished PDF and Word version is in the GapToGrowth GitHub repository under `examples/reference-resumes/`.

## Layout specs
- One page, US Letter, single column. No tables, text boxes, columns, icons, photos, or header or footer content.
- Margins: 0.7 inch on all sides.
- Font: Calibri. Body 11 pt. Name 16 pt, bold, all caps, centered.
- Contact line: centered, 10 pt, items separated by " | ".
- Section headings: 11 pt, bold, all caps, with a thin line underneath.
- Entry first line: organization in bold on the left, location right-aligned on the same line.
- Entry second line: job title in italics on the left, dates in italics right-aligned.
- Bullets: 3 to 5 for recent roles, 2 to 3 for older roles. Start with an action verb, end with a measurable result. No "I", no "responsible for".
- Section order: Summary, Experience, Skills, Education, Certifications.
